answer: Pay only for distinct, peer-verified work. Each epoch every account writes an answer that is compared with all others; near-duplicates are folded together and share one reward, and randomly drawn graders must rate it before it pays. A farm cannot let fifty clones wander through one template, since even an ivory-smooth paraphrase still trips the similarity check. Each fake needs its own genuinely new, good work every epoch, so cost rises with every clone, and a farm that stops paying it fades like an ember.
